subject: general
question: Who is the current Chief Minister of Delhi as of March 2025, and from which constituency was he/she elected in the 2025 Delhi Assembly elections?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rekha Gupta from Shalimar Bagh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Rekha Gupta** was elected as the **Chief Minister of Delhi **in the **2025 Delhi Assembly elections**.
 
• She contested and won the election from the **Shalimar Bagh constituency**.
 
• Rekha Gupta belongs to the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), marking a significant political shift in Delhi's governance.
 
• Her victory is notable as it ended the prolonged tenure of the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) in Delhi.
 
• She focused on issues such as urban development, women’s safety, and infrastructure enhancement during her campaign.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chief Minister's Role and Responsibilities:**

 
 
• The Chief Minister is the executive head of a state government in India.
 
• Key responsibilities include policy formulation, ensuring governance, and representing the state in various forums.
 
• The Chief Minister works alongside the Governor, who is the ceremonial head of the state.
 
 
 
• **Delhi Assembly Elections:**
 
 
• Delhi has a unicameral legislature, consisting of 70 assembly seats.
 
• The elections are conducted under the supervision of the Election Commission of India.
 
• The party or coalition with the majority forms the government, and the leader of the majority party becomes the Chief Minister.
 
 
 
• **Shalimar Bagh Constituency:**
 
 
• Shalimar Bagh is one of the 70 assembly constituencies in Delhi.
 
• It is known for its urban demographic and plays a significant role in Delhi's political landscape.
 
 
 
• **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP):**
 
 
• The BJP is one of the major national political parties in India.
 
• Founded in 1980, the BJP advocates for nationalism, economic development, and strong governance.
 
• The party has a significant presence both at the central and state levels across India.
